findings_qualitative.value: Clumpy dense CO clouds are embedded in both shock-ionized and photoionized lobes; clouds A, B, D coincide with an optical dark lane.

evidence.quote: The densest molecular clouds, named A, B, and D, show a good spatial correspondence with the optical dark lane

claims.hypothesis: Dense molecular clouds exist within the optical nebula of N63A
claims.experiment: ALMA 12CO(1-0) mosaic compared with HST, Chandra, ATCA
claims.result: Eleven clouds A–K, ~800 Msun (shock-ionized) and ~1700 Msun (photoionized)
claims.finding: First detection of dense molecular clouds embedded in the optical nebula

evidence.quote: The total mass of the molecular clouds is $\sim$800 $M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ for the shock-ionized region

claims.hypothesis: Clouds have been engulfed by shocks
claims.experiment: Compare X-ray absorbing column with total ISM proton column
claims.finding: X-rays are produced in front of the clouds; clouds engulfed but survive

evidence.quote: This means that the X-rays are produced not only behind the molecular clouds, but also in front of them.

claims.hypothesis: Hard X-rays in SE arise from shock-cloud interaction
claims.experiment: Fit SE spectrum with PL or 2NEI models
claims.finding: Cannot discriminate synchrotron from high-T plasma
